hook.context: Sample is a review snapshot of the proposed ticket notification hook. Included below are its implementation and the event contract for its intended host. Review it read-only.

files.sample/README.md:
# Ticket notice

Subscribers receive one notification per newly opened ticket. Only the ticket number goes to the delivery service.
files.sample/delivery.py:
def opened(ticket, delivery):
    delivery.send({"ticket": ticket.id, "body": ticket.body})
files.sample/host-contract.txt: The host can redeliver an opened event with the same ticket identifier after a timeout. Delivery.send sends a separate notification on each call.
